bracu_official.title: BRAC University to Host Second Khondker Mahbubuddin Ahmed Memorial International Moot Court Competition 2026
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University is set to host its second international moot court competition, named in memory of Khondker Mahbubuddin Ahmed. The event will bring together participants for a significant legal challenge.
